name: Separation Anxiety
summary: Huntsman Markhor grieves for his twin, Malkhor, in Revantusk Village. The Vilebranch took Malkhor in the raid that took Torntusk's mate. Markhor believes Malkhor's soul can still be rescued, though his life is beyond saving. So he asks you to recover the remains.

sections.title: A Twin's Loss
sections.body: Many in Revantusk Village have lost loved ones to the wilds, Markhor says. His own grief is for his twin brother, Malkhor. The Vilebranch took Malkhor in the raid that took Torntusk's mate. His captors killed him swiftly and brutally; he was not fated to live.

sections.title: Where the Remains Lie
sections.body: The Vilebranch fed Malkhor's remains to their oozes and wolves. Near the top of the temple of Jintha'alor are a refuse pit filled with oozes and a wolf den. His bones rest in a sludge pit near the top tier, while his skull lies on the tier itself. Markhor plans to carry the remains to Yayo'jin, who will prepare them for a proper burial.

faq.answer: Malkhor was Huntsman Markhor's twin brother. The Vilebranch took him in the raid that also took Torntusk's mate, then killed him swiftly and brutally.
The Vilebranch fed Malkhor's remains to their oozes and wolves. His skull lies on Jintha'alor's top tier, while his bones rest in a sludge pit near that tier.

faq.q: Who will prepare Malkhor for burial?
faq.answer: Markhor will take Malkhor's remains to Yayo'jin, who will prepare them for a proper burial.

faq.q: Why does Markhor need the bones returned?
faq.answer: Markhor says Malkhor's life is beyond saving, but his soul can still be rescued. He wants the remains recovered so that Malkhor's soul may be saved.
